ValidationRule.description: Term loans and equipment financing cannot disburse more than the principal. Lines of credit are exempt because repaid amounts can be drawn again.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Loan_Product__c, "Line of Credit")), Total_Disbursed__c > Principal_Amount__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Completed disbursements can't exceed the principal amount on a term loan or equipment financing.
